orientation.technical_envelope: Repeat the supported ecological fit on the four predeclared +/-5% bbox translations as bounded sensitivity; baseline plus shifts are one technical envelope, not five evidence votes.

visible_colour.transform: Identity for lightness, registered legacy chroma and circular hue sine/cosine; Hellinger square-root transform for the four registered closed composition fractions.
visible_colour.joint_support: All eight registered colour endpoints must be operationally eligible on the same heads/images/observation. Hue sine/cosine are one circular quantity and the four Hellinger coordinates are one closed-composition quantity; neither is counted as independent repeated biological evidence.
visible_colour.composition_rule: Require each fraction finite and >=0 and the four fractions sum to 1 within 1e-6 before square root. Never renormalize a non-closed row.
visible_colour.hue_rule: Require sqrt(hue_sin^2+hue_cos^2) <= 1+1e-6. Do not convert mean sine/cosine back to a single linear angle for the primary model.
visible_colour.chroma_rule: Primary uses the already-qualified registered corolla_lab_chroma exactly as measured. The uniformly-floral-union candidate remains a separate versioned candidate and cannot silently replace this coordinate without an explicit later measurement decision.

gross_shape.joint_support: All four endpoints must share the same operational heads/images/observation.
gross_shape.technical_envelope: Repeat the supported ecological fit on the four predeclared +/-5% bbox translations as bounded sensitivity; do not select a favourable formulation.

response_scaling: Do not fit separate taxon- or scale-specific response standardizations. Primary coefficients remain in the transformed registered response units. Joint process statistics use the bootstrap covariance/rank geometry, which is unit-aware; any display-standardized effects are secondary and use one saved transformation across within and among scales.
excluded_primary_module: visible_display is descriptive/construct-bounded and fine_architecture_and_surface is measurement-blocked; neither occupies the 36 primary probability slots.
missingness: No imputation, row-wise endpoint substitution or outcome-driven reduced module. A module fit uses its exact joint support; source rows and partial endpoint values remain in assessability accounting.
